legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors, assigns, and personal representatives.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless Assignee against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from any breach of Assignor's representations, warranties, or covenants.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and expenses associated with the conveyance of the Property.
